question: Tropical Evergreen Forests are found in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tropical Evergreen Forests** are characterized by dense vegetation, high biodiversity, and remain green throughout the year due to high rainfall and humidity.
 
• These forests are predominantly found in the Western Ghats, including the state of **Kerala**, which receives heavy rainfall throughout the year.
 
• The tropical evergreen forests in Kerala are known for their rich flora, including species like rosewood, mahogany, and ebony, as well as diverse fauna such as tigers, elephants, and various bird species.
 
• Kerala's tropical evergreen forests are part of the **Western Ghats UNESCO World Heritage Site**, a global biodiversity hotspot.
 
• These forests play a crucial role in regulating the climate, maintaining soil fertility, and serving as a habitat for numerous endemic species.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tropical Evergreen Forests** are typically found in regions with more than 200 cm of annual rainfall and a temperature range of 25-30°C, such as the Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and parts of northeastern India.
 
• These forests have a multi-layered structure, with tall trees forming a continuous canopy and smaller trees, shrubs, and ground vegetation growing underneath.
 
• Important ecosystems within tropical evergreen forests include **rainforests**, which are critical for global oxygen production and carbon dioxide absorption.
 
• Kerala's forests are also home to numerous medicinal plants and are a source of important forest products like timber, spices, and honey.
 
• Conservation efforts in tropical evergreen forests focus on mitigating deforestation, protecting endangered species, and promoting sustainable use of forest resources.
